$comment: Copied into the calibration sandbox as .claude/settings.local.json. Both marketplace installs of the pipeline plugin are disabled so the sandbox only ever runs the plugin build under calibration. The hooks block carries only the three observability hooks (tool-use log, subagent log, agent-cost capture) so a calibration run can price itself; every command is rooted at ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} because the sandbox project has no hooks/ directory of its own. Dogfood-only hooks are deliberately not carried.
